headline: Executive order changes the rules federal agencies follow when planning and reviewing new regulations.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12866, which sets the process federal agencies use to plan, write, and get White House review of new regulations. The title says it makes further changes to that process. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They must follow the updated planning and review steps when developing rules.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses, groups, and people covered by federal rules
who_it_affects.how: Changes to how rules are reviewed could affect how new federal rules are made.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 18, 2007; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
